=== while simple
start
while (data available?)
  :read data;
  :generate diagrams;
endwhile
stop
=== while is not
start
while (check filesize ?) is (not empty)
  :read file;
endwhile (empty)
:close file;
stop
=== while empty body
start
while (forever?)
endwhile
:after;
=== while empty body labels
while (c) is (yes)
endwhile (no)
stop
=== while long test
start
while (this is a very long condition text that goes on and on?) is (yes it is true)
  :a;
endwhile (finally no)
:b;
=== while multiline test
while (first line\nsecond line\nthird line) is (yes)
  :a;
endwhile
=== while backward
start
while (c?) is (yes)
  :a;
  backward:back;
endwhile (no)
stop
=== while backward style
while (c?)
  :a;
  backward:back; <<input>>
endwhile
=== while backward arrow labels
while (c?) is (yes)
  :a;
  -> into backward;
  backward:back;
  -> out of backward;
endwhile (no)
=== while backward multiline
while (c?)
  :a;
  :b;
  backward:going\nback\nnow;
endwhile
=== while break
start
while (c?)
  :a;
  break
endwhile
:after;
stop
=== while break after actions
while (c?) is (yes)
  :a;
  :b;
  break
endwhile (no)
:z;
=== while kill
while (c?)
  :a;
  kill
endwhile
:z;
=== while detach
while (c?)
  :a;
  detach
endwhile
=== while stop after
start
while (c?)
  :a;
endwhile
stop
=== while end after
start
while (c?) is (yes)
  :a;
endwhile (no)
end
=== while stop after label
start
while (c?) is (yes)
  :a;
endwhile (done)
stop
=== while kill after
while (c?)
  :a;
endwhile
kill
=== while nested
start
while (outer?)
  :a;
  while (inner?)
    :b;
  endwhile
  :c;
endwhile
stop
=== while nested backward
while (outer?)
  while (inner?)
    :b;
    backward:ib;
  endwhile
  backward:ob;
endwhile
=== while arrow labels inside
while (c?)
  -> first;
  :a;
  -> second;
  :b;
endwhile
=== while colored arrows
while (c?)
  -[#red]->
  :a;
  -[#blue,dashed]-> lbl;
  :b;
endwhile
-[#green]-> out;
:z;
=== while colored diamond
#yellow:while (c?) is (yes)
  :a;
endwhile
=== while color endwhile arrow
while (c?)
  :a;
endwhile
-[#red]->
:z;
=== while bold arrow
while (c?)
  :a;
  -[bold]->
endwhile
=== while hidden arrow
while (c?)
  :a;
  -[hidden]->
endwhile
=== while condition inside hexagon
skinparam conditionStyle inside
while (c?) is (yes)
  :a;
endwhile (no)
=== while condition diamond
skinparam conditionStyle diamond
while (c?) is (yes)
  :a;
endwhile (no)
=== while condition empty diamond
skinparam conditionStyle InsideDiamond
while (c?) is (yes)
  :a;
endwhile (no)
=== while condition foo1
skinparam conditionStyle foo1
while (c?) is (yes)
  :a;
endwhile (no)
=== while swimlanes same lane
|A|
start

  :a;

stop

|A|
start

  |B|
  :b;
endwhile

stop
=== while swimlanes three lanes
|A|
start
:x;
while (c?) is (yes)
  |B|
  :b;
  |C|
  :c;
endwhile (no)
|A|
:y;
=== while swimlanes backward
|A|
while (c?)
  :a;
  |B|
  backward:back;
endwhile
=== while swimlanes back lane
|A|
:a0;
|B|
while (c?)
  :b;
  |A|
  :a;
endwhile
|B|
:b2;
=== while then repeat
while (c?)
  :a;
endwhile
repeat
  :b;
repeat while (d?)
=== repeat simple
start
repeat
  :read data;
  :generate diagrams;
repeat while (more data?)
stop
=== repeat labels
start
repeat :foo as starting label;
  :read data;
  :generate diagrams;
repeat while (more data?) is (yes) not (no)
stop
=== repeat start label style
repeat :start; <<output>>
  :a;
repeat while (c?)
=== repeat backward
start
repeat
  :a;
  backward:This is backward;
repeat while (c?) is (yes)
stop
=== repeat backward note
repeat
  :a;
  backward:back;
  note right: a note on backward
repeat while (c?)
=== repeat backward style
repeat
  :a;
  backward:back; <<procedure>>
repeat while (c?)
=== repeat arrow color
repeat
  :a;
repeat while (c?) -[#red]->
:z;
=== repeat arrow label
repeat
  :a;
repeatwhile (c?) -[#blue]-> back label;
:z;
=== repeat arrow dashed
repeat
  :a;
repeat while (c?) -[dashed]-> loop;
=== repeat while multiline
repeat
  :a;
repeat while (line one\nline two) is (y) not (n)

  :a;
  break
repeat while (c?)
:after;

  :a;

  repeat
    :b;

=== repeat in while
while (outer?)
  repeat
    :b;
  repeat while (inner?)
endwhile
=== while in repeat
repeat
  while (inner?)
    :b;
  endwhile
repeat while (outer?)

  -> lbl1;
  :a;
  -[#red]-> lbl2;
  :b;

  :a;

repeat
  :a very long action label that is wide;

=== loops with start stop
start
:init;
repeat
  :step;
  while (sub?)
    :x;
    backward:y;
  endwhile
repeat while (again?) is (yes)
-> done;
stop
=== while two breaks
while (c?)
  :a;
  break
  :b;
endwhile
=== repeat two breaks
repeat
  :a;
  break
  :b;
  break
repeat while (c?)
=== while rainbow arrows
while (c?)
  -[#red;#blue]->
  :a;
  -[#green;#yellow;#black]-> label;
endwhile
-[#red;#green]->
:z;

repeat
  :a;
repeat while (c?) -[#red;#blue]-> back;

=== style arrow loops
<style>
activityDiagram {
  arrow {
    LineColor blue
    FontColor green
  }
  diamond {
    BackgroundColor pink
    LineColor red
  }
}
</style>
while (c?) is (yes)
  :a;
endwhile (no)
repeat
  :b;
